name: Thread Retrofit
status: reference only -- the first run over the backlog; the same script is also the last step of the nightly Metadata pass
description: Brings Threads captured before a format change up to the current shape, from data already in the vault -- no re-capture. Rebuilds the Conversation index from the message notes, adds kind/thread, kind/email and kind/attachment, and removes the mailbox owner's own participant links.

steps.name: Rebuild the Conversation index
steps.description: From the message notes, sorted; written only when it changed.

steps.name: Kind tags
steps.description: kind/thread, kind/email, kind/attachment -- added only where absent.

steps.name: Remove the owner
steps.description: Needs SECOND_BRAIN_SELF_EMAIL; without it this step is skipped, and capture stops excluding the owner.

notes: The first run over a large backlog is slow: every Thread is written, and each write resolves the Thread by id. Nightly it touches only what changed.
